title: Profiling declaration
description: A repository's profiling declaration, .ops/config/profiling.yaml: the commands it measures under each profiler and the most each may cost. One object per profiler, keyed by the profiler's name; under it one object per command, keyed by the command's cli words; under that one integer per measure, named as the profiler's @totals names it. Which profilers exist and which measures each reports is the profile kind's to check, not this schema's.

additionalProperties.description: The commands measured under one profiler, keyed by their cli words.
The most one command may cost, one integer per measure the profiler reports.
